info.name: PlanRadar's API Documentation Approval Requests V2 Report Templates V2 API

params.name: last_sync_date
params.description: is a Unix Timestamp. If it is set, only report templates that were created after that timestamp will be returned

params.name: pagesize
params.description:
sets the number of report templates that should be returned per page
Maximum is 500, default is 100

params.name: page
params.description: sets the number of pages for the returned report templates

params.name: type
params.description: limits the response to a specific template type

items.docs:
This API returns all report templates of a customer. Report templates can be of type PDF or XLS Extra parameters can be added to filter and sort the results.
Report Template Sorting: The results can be sorted by name, creation time or creator The sort is always ascending unless the field name is prefixed with a minus i.e. -created-at
Example#1: Sorting report templates by the creator `/report_templates?sort=created-by`
